title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 4: Tell a clear story

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Say the time phrase and the background detail together. Write one true memory in your notes, close them, then describe another place or routine without reading.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Quand j'étais étudiant, je prenais le bus chaque matin.
steps.en: When I was a student, I used to take the bus every morning.
steps.tip: Say it: kah(n) zhay-TEH ay-tü-DYAH(N) zhuh pruh-NEH luh büs shahk mah-TA(N)

steps.fr: À cette époque, nous habitions près du centre.
steps.en: At that time, we lived near the centre.
steps.tip: Say it: ah seht ay-POHK noo zah-bee-TYOH(N) preh dü sah(n)tr

steps.fr: Il y avait un petit café au coin de la rue.
steps.en: There was a small café at the corner.
steps.tip: Say it: eel ee ah-VEH uh(n) puh-TEE kah-FAY oh kwa(n) duh lah rü

steps.fr: D'habitude, le quartier était calme le soir.
steps.en: Usually, the neighbourhood was quiet in the evening.
steps.tip: Say it: dah-bee-TÜD luh kahr-TYAY ay-TEH kahlm luh swahr

steps.fr: Pendant l'hiver, il faisait souvent froid le matin.
steps.en: During winter, it was often cold in the morning.
steps.tip: Say it: pah(n)-DAH(N) lee-VEHR eel fuh-ZEH soo-VAH(N) frwah luh mah-TA(N)

steps.fr: La salle avait de grandes fenêtres.
steps.tip: Say it: lah sahl ah-VEH duh grah(n)d fuh-NEHTR

steps.fr: Le dimanche, ma famille se retrouvait chez ma tante.
steps.en: On Sundays, my family used to meet at my aunt's home.
steps.tip: Say it: luh dee-MAH(N)sh mah fah-MEEY suh ruh-troo-VEH shay mah tah(n)t

steps.fr: On se promenait près de la rivière après le repas.
steps.en: We used to walk near the river after the meal.
steps.tip: Say it: ohn suh proh-muh-NEH preh duh lah ree-VYEHR ah-preh luh ruh-PAH
